selection_rule.principle: Selection and human labeling are prediction-blind with respect to E0.5. No E0.5 recommendation, blocker, review code or dimension is used.
selection_rule.eligibility: Canonical record in source inventory with description.detail_status=FULL and canonical_id not present in the previously human-labeled E0.3, E0.4 temporal, or E0.4.2 blind sets.

strata.name: fresh_new
strata.rule: Include all eligible records whose authoritative state seen_status is NEW in the post-freeze source run.

strata.name: direct_profile_title
strata.rule: Include all remaining eligible target academic/research titles containing a declared profile-domain anchor in the title.

strata.name: direct_profile_context
strata.rule: Include all remaining eligible target titles whose Full JD contains at least two high-specificity direct exercise/sport/rehabilitation profile anchors.

strata.name: target_profile_anchor
strata.rule: Deterministic SHA256 sample from remaining target titles with a profile anchor anywhere in title or Full JD.

strata.name: target_specialist
strata.rule: Deterministic SHA256 sample from remaining target titles with specialist-method/discipline terminology.

strata.name: target_no_anchor
strata.rule: Deterministic SHA256 sample from remaining target titles with no profile anchor.

strata.name: non_target_boundary
strata.rule: Deterministic SHA256 sample from remaining non-target titles that nevertheless contain profile-adjacent terminology, to test role-identity boundaries.

labeling_policy: Explicit hard blockers, expired vacancies, predoctoral roles, regulated-professional mismatches and clearly unrelated roles -> SKIP. Genuine uncertainty or plausible adjacent fit -> REVIEW. Direct fit without material blocker -> APPLY/STRONG_APPLY. False-negative cost is treated as higher than moderate false-positive cost.
methodology_note: Prediction-blind but not double-blind: the candidate implementation is known to the maintainer. Human labels are locked in repository history before any E0.5 predictions on this source inventory are revealed. Labels must not be edited after scoring.
